name: Down to Clown: The Official Clown Dating Sim
source:
In Down to Clown: The Official Clown Dating Sim, you get to join a struggling circus in need of a new act, but when most of the performers quit before the next big show, it's up to you to come up with an act and save the circus. Along the way, you'll have the chance to pursue romantic relationships with your clown coworkers, in a slice-of-life story that explores the challenges and joys of relationships, set against the colorful and whimsical backdrop of the circus.

Your decisions will determine the fate of your relationships and the fate of the circus. Will you be able to save the day and find love in the process?

[from [url=https://candycornskull.itch.io/down-to-clown-the-offical-clown-dating-sim]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Down to Clown：官方小丑约会模拟》中，你要加入一个陷入困境、需要新表演的马戏团，但当大多数表演者在下一场大型演出之前退出时，你就得想出一个表演来拯救马戏团。一路上，你将有机会与你的小丑同事追求浪漫的关系，在一个生活片段的故事中，探索关系的挑战和乐趣，以马戏团丰富多彩和异想天开的背景为背景。

你的决定将决定你们人际关系的命运以及马戏团的命运。你能在这个过程中拯救世界并找到爱情吗？
